map.根据分子式计算摩尔质量(g/mol): Compute the molar mass (g/mol) from the molecular formula
map.📖 查看「摩尔质量计算 使用指南」: 📖 View the usage guide for 'Molar Mass Calculation'
map.依据 IUPAC 相对原子质量，按化学式各元素原子量求和得到摩尔质量（g/mol: Based on IUPAC relative atomic masses, the molar mass (g/mol) is obtained by summing the atomic weights of the elements in the chemical formula, with support for parenthesised hydrates and common ions; atomic weights use standard values, and the result can serve as a reference for solution preparation and reaction stoichiometry. Computed locally in the front end, data never leaves the browser.
map.化学式摩尔质量：解析 H₂SO₄、Ca(OH)₂ 等，按 IUPAC 原子量求和: Chemical formula molar mass: parse formulas such as H₂SO₄ and Ca(OH)₂ and sum the IUPAC atomic weights to obtain g/mol.
map.溶液配制物质的量换算：由质量与目标浓度反算所需溶质数与定容体积。: Solution preparation mole conversion: back-calculate the required solute moles and the volumetric flask volume from the mass and target concentration.
map.反应计量比核算：按配平方程式的系数比换算各物质投料摩尔关系。: Reaction stoichiometry accounting: convert the molar relationships of each substance from the coefficients of the balanced equation.
map.输入 H2SO4，工具解析 H×2、S×1、O×4，按原子量输出约 98.08: Entering H2SO4, the tool parses H×2, S×1, O×4 and outputs about 98.08 g/mol by atomic weight, giving a weighing reference of 98.08g per 1mol.
map.原子量用哪个标准？: Which standard is used for atomic weights?
map.采用 IUPAC 公布的相对原子质量（区间值取常用标准原子量）；对放射性/不稳定: The relative atomic masses published by IUPAC are used (for interval values the common standard atomic weight is taken); for radioactive/unstable elements the most stable isotope governs.
map.把结晶水计入分子式（如 CuSO₄·5H₂O），分别求和再相加；注意括号与系数展: Include the water of crystallisation in the formula (e.g. CuSO₄·5H₂O), sum each part separately and then add them; watch the expansion of parentheses and coefficients.
map.对分子物质近似同义；对离子化合物用「式量」更准确。本工具统一以 g/mol 输出: For molecular substances they are approximately synonymous; for ionic compounds 'formula weight' is more accurate. This tool uniformly outputs molar mass in g/mol.
map.摩尔质量计算工具：按化学式解析原子量求和得到摩尔质量，支持水合物与常见离子，辅助: A molar mass calculation tool: parses atomic weights by chemical formula and sums them to obtain the molar mass, supporting hydrates and common ions, assisting solution preparation and reaction stoichiometry. Processed in the front end, with data computed locally to protect privacy.
map.规格/参数一键换算：按公式实时得出结果: One-click specification/parameter conversion: results in real time by formula
map.本地计算：数据不出浏览器，保护业务数据: Local computation: data never leaves the browser, protecting business data
map.结果可复制导出：便于记录与复核: Results can be copied and exported: convenient for records and re-checking
map.支持常用单位切换：减少人工换算误差: Supports switching common units: reduces manual conversion errors
